title: Linear FM Waveform
text: Linear FM (LFM) pulse waveform, 2 inputs, 3 outputs; {Sample rate (Hz)} sets the sample rate of the output, {Method to specify pulse duration} sets the pulse duration as time or duty cycle Pulse, {Pulse width (s)} sets the time duration, {Duty cycle} sets the waveform duty cycle, {Pulse repetition frequency (Hz)} sets the pulse repetition frequency 1e4, {Enable PRF selection input} selects predefined PRF, {Sweep bandwidth (Hz)} sets the bandwidth of FM, {Sweep direction} sets the direction of FM, {Sweep interval} sets the fM frequency sweep, {Envelope function} sets the fM signal amplitude, {Source of Frequency Offset} sets the source of frequency, {Frequency Offset (Hz)} sets the frequency offset, {Source of simulation sample time}, {Output signal format} sets the format of the output, {Number of samples in output}, {Number of pulses in output}, {Enable PRF Output} enables output of PRF, {Enable Matched Filter Coefficients Output} enables output of matched filter and {Simulate using} sets the block simulation method Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Sample rate (Hz)
params.values: Sample rate of the output waveform 1e6 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Method to specify pulse duration
params.values: Pulse duration as time or duty cycle Pulse width (default) | Duty cycle

params.name: Pulse width (s)
params.values: Time duration of pulse 50e-6 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Duty cycle
params.values: Waveform duty cycle 0.5 (default) | scalar in the range [0,1]

params.name: Sweep bandwidth (Hz)
params.values: Bandwidth of FM sweep 1e5 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Sweep direction
params.values: Direction of FM sweep Up (default) | Down

params.name: Sweep interval
params.values: FM frequency sweep interval Positive (default) | Symmetric

params.name: Envelope function
params.values: FM signal amplitude envelope Rectangular (default) | Gaussian

params.name: Source of Frequency Offset
params.values: Source of frequency offset Property (default) | Input port

params.name: Source of simulation sample time
params.values: Source of simulation sample time Derive from waveform parameters (default) | Inherit from Simulink engine

params.name: Output signal format
params.values: Format of the output signal Pulses (default) | Samples

params.name: Number of samples in output
params.values: Number of samples in output 100 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Number of pulses in output
params.values: Number of pulses in output 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Enable PRF Output
params.values: Enable output of PRF off (default) | on

params.name: Enable Matched Filter Coefficients Output
params.values: Enable output of matched filter coefficients off (default) | on

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Block simulation method Interpreted Execution (default) | Code Generation
